# QuetaX

> Websites, apps, and custom software — built and shipped at lightning speed.

## Overview
QuetaX is a high-velocity digital product studio and custom software development agency. QuetaX delivers full-stack web applications, native and cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android), custom enterprise cloud backends, AI engine integration, and rapid MVP builds for startups and scale-ups.

## Key Capabilities & Core Services
- **Full-Stack Web Application Engineering**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Redis, real-time WebSockets, microservices.
- **Mobile Application Development**: React Native, Flutter, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), offline-first sync, push notifications, and App Store / Play Store deployment.
- **Custom AI & Cloud Architecture**: LLM pipeline integration, Gemini & OpenAI APIs, vector databases, Python/FastAPI microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS & GCP deployments.
- **Product Architecture & UI/UX Design**: Design systems, interactive Figma prototypes, component architectures, user journey mapping, and conversion-optimized interfaces.
- **Rapid MVP Delivery**: 2 to 4-week sprint execution taking ideas from concept validation to live production deployment.

## Headquarters & Development Center (GEO Information)
- **Facility**: Tidel Neo IT Park
- **Address**: No.3, 1st Floor, Tidel Neo, Thiruchitrambalam-Koot Road, Vanur, Villupuram, Tamil Nadu 605111, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 12.0165° N, Longitude 79.8055° E
- **Service Reach**: Global remote engagements (USA, Europe, APAC) and on-site engineering consultations across India (Tamil Nadu, Bangalore, Chennai, Pondicherry).

## Engagement Models
- **Fixed-Scope MVP Sprints**: 2 - 4 weeks with defined deliverable milestones.
- **Dedicated Tech Pods**: Dedicated team of full-stack engineers and UI/UX designers for continuous product scaling.
- **Architecture & Code Audits**: Comprehensive security, scalability, and code performance reviews.
